SECTION 3 — GRI 300
Environmental Performance
Environmental stewardship is central to our sustainability strategy. This section covers GHG emissions, energy
consumption, water management, waste, biodiversity, climate risk, materials, and air quality disclosures.
3.1 GHG Emissions
GRI 305
Management Approach
Swiggy is committed to minimizing the carbon footprint of our operations, primarily focusing on electrifying our delivery fleet. Our Scope 1
and 2 emissions arise from our corporate offices, dark stores (Instamart), and fuel used by company-owned vehicles. However, our most
significant emissions are Scope 3, specifically from the delivery fleet operated by our delivery partners (gig workers). We actively partner with
EV rental platforms and OEMs to increase EV adoption among our. Fleet.
Emission reduction targets Effectiveness is tracked via EV delivery distance vs ICE delivery distance, dark store energy consumption
metrics, and total Scope 3 carbon intensity per order. The sustainability team reviews these metrics
quarterly to optimize our EV transition strategy.
